entries.en: Hatching-tide was first founded when our dear friend Jihli was blessed with a vision by the Twelve Archons of ages past, those legendary heroes said to have saved the realm from destruction during the Sixth Umbral Calamity.
entries.macro: Hatching<-->tide was first founded when our dear friend Jihli was blessed with a vision by the Twelve Archons of ages past, those legendary heroes said to have saved the realm from destruction during the Sixth Umbral Calamity.
entries.fr: Il s'agit d'un événement festif qui commence dès qu'une vision étrange apparaît dans les rêves de Jihli Aliapoh.
entries.ja:
エッグハントとはそもそも、
グリダニアの少女「ジリ・アリアポー」が見た、
不思議な夢から始まったお祭りなんだ。

entries.en: The Archons appeared to her in a dream, descending from the heavens atop beautifully decorated eggs. “Arise, young Dreamer,” they whispered, “and make ready the vessels for our return.” And so she did─painstakingly painting and gilding eggs to match those from her vision.
entries.fr: On raconte que la première célébration est même plus ancienne que le septième fléau. Dans son rêve, les Preux chevauchaient fièrement des œufs, alors une grande chasse au “Prœuf” a été organisée pour les inciter à venir parmi nous.
entries.ja:
……話は、第七霊災の前に遡る。
彼女の夢に現れた「卵に乗った賢者様」をお迎えするために、
飾りタマゴを探す「エッグハント」の催しが始まった。

entries.en: Word of the prophecy spread, and Jihli attracted helpers to assist in her travails. After the Calamity, the festival grew further, as townsfolk and adventurers flocked to celebrate the Archons of yore, who were rumored to have had some hand in saving the realm from destruction once again.
entries.fr: La suite, vous la connaissez sans doute... Les Preux nous ont sauvés lorsque le Fléau s'est abattu sur nous. Nous avons décidé de continuer à organiser ces chasses pour que personne n'oublie jamais ce que nous leur devons.
entries.ja:
そして実際に、賢者様は霊災から人々をお救いになったんだ。
そのことへの感謝の気持ちを忘れないために、
僕たちはエッグハントのお祭りを続けているんだよ。

entries.en: Although a group of dedicated Dreamers still strive to realize Jihli's visions and fulfill the prophecies therein, most adventurers nowadays are more keen to partake in the famous egg hunts, and win the wonderful prizes that lie hidden within the decorated eggs.
entries.fr: Cette année, comme les années précédentes, vous allez devoir chercher des Prœufs en tout genre, mais la grande nouveauté, c'est qu'on va vous demander de vous changer en spriggan. Vous savez, ce sont ces petites bêtes noires à l'air malicieux !

タマゴを探すという趣向なんだ！

entries.en: This year, we are asking adventurers to disguise themselves as cheeky spriggans before joining the hunt. There are rumors that a special auspicious spriggan might make an appearance too, with the promise of rich reward for whosoever follows it to its destination. Be sure to keep your eyes peeled!
entries.fr: Toutes les cités éorzéennes ont été décorées pour les festivités, et les gens ne parlent plus que du “spriggan porte-bonheur”. Ce monstre un peu particulier joue apparemment un rôle prépondérant lors de cet événement.

entries.en: This year, the hunt for eggs and prizes is not confined to the cities alone. Out in the wilds of Eorzea, giant eggs lay in wait for any sturdy soul willing to try their hand at cracking them open. But be wary, adventurer─these eggs fight back! The hunter becomes the hunted!
entries.fr: Nous n'avons pas fait les choses à moitié cette année, parce que vous allez aussi devoir sortir des cités-États et chasser les Prœufs dans tout Éorzéa !

entries.en:
In Jihli's vision, it was spriggans that she saw pirouetting around the floating eggs, and who are we to argue with the will of the Archons? Hence have we enlisted the aid of a band of sylphic sorceresses, to magick any adventurer who wishes to join the hunt into spriggan form.
Attack the egg until it cracks, and who knows what wonders you might find inside?

entries.en: The festival was founded by our friend and leader Miss Jihli Aliapoh, who was chosen by the Twelve Archons of ages past. They blessed her with a prophetic dream heralding their return, in which she saw them descend from the clouds atop gloriously patterned eggs, speaking these words:

entries.en: “Arise, young Dreamer, and make ready the vessels for our return!” And so she did─decorating myriad eggs to match those from her dream, in readiness for the Archons' emergence. Yet the eggs would oft be stolen by spriggans, and would needs be recovered before Hatching Hour struck.

entries.en:
Long and hard did we ponder how to convincingly disguise adventurers as spriggans to bring the scenes from Jihli's vision to life. Their limbs are too thin to make a costume feasible, and besides, we would need to skin an army of the creatures to clothe the requisite number of revelers.
But just when we thought all hope was lost, a band of sylphic sorceresses came to our aid, offering the use of their skin-changing magicks to temporarily transfigure adventurers into a suitably furry form.

entries.en: Well met, my friend. Do you seek to learn more of this year's Hatching-tide festivities? The Archons of times past have bestowed a new vision upon our dear leader, complete with a new prophecy. We Dreamers have taken it upon ourselves to see it fulfilled, and bring great joy to the realm!

entries.en: You know not of the famous egg hunt? Of the prophecy of the Archons' return? Then you are in for a treat. It all started many years ago, before the Calamity struck, when Jihli Aliapoh was visited in her dreams by the Twelve Archons, those heroes of an age long past.
entries.fr: C'est une grrrande fête qui est née lorsque Jihli Aliapoh a eu une vision un peu spéciale...
entries.ja:
エッグハントとはそもそも、
グリダニアの少女「ジリ・アリアポー」が見た、
不思議な夢から始まったお祭りなんだ。

entries.en: They descended from the heavens atop brilliantly colored eggs, and prophesied their return, bidding her prepare the vessels for their arrival in Eorzea. Just as instructed, Jihli set about collecting as many eggs as she could muster, and decorating them to match those she witnessed in her dream.
entries.fr: J'ai entendu dire que tout avait commencé avant que le derrrnier Fléau ne s'abatte sur nous. Jihli avait fait un rêve dans lequel les Preux chevauchaient des œufs, et les rêveuses ont décidé d'organiser cet événement pour les accueillir en bonne et due forme.
entries.ja:
……話は、第七霊災の前に遡る。
彼女の夢に現れた「卵に乗った賢者様」をお迎えするために、
飾りタマゴを探す「エッグハント」の催しが始まった。

entries.en: As the years passed, the festival grew, as Jihli attracted a dual band of followers: we who assist her in spreading the Archons' message and preparing for their return, and revelers who celebrate the day by partaking in the egg hunts that have become a Hatching-tide tradition.

entries.fr: Tout le monde a été surpris quand le Fléau est arrivé et que les Prrreux sont vraiment venus sauver les hommes... Alors nous avons décidé d'exprimer notre gratitude en continuant à organiser cet événement régulièrement.
entries.ja:
そして実際に、賢者様は霊災から人々をお救いになったんだ。
そのことへの感謝の気持ちを忘れないために、
僕たちはエッグハントのお祭りを続けているんだよ。

entries.en: This year, the hunt is slightly changed in form, though, to be precise, it is the hunters who are doing the changing. The Archons have visited Jihli's dreams once more, and revealed to her a vision of the future: a world where spriggans, not men, hunted the Hatching-tide eggs.

entries.fr: Les participants vont d'habitude chercher des œufs décorés, mais nous avons décidé d'innover cette année en leur demandant de se changer en petit spriggan farrrceur avant de partir à la chasse !

今回はなんと、いたずら好きの魔物「スプリガン」に変身して、
タマゴを探すという趣向なんだ！

entries.en: But fear not, for they were not real spriggans, but adventurers in disguise! With the aid of sylphic skin-changers, you too can join in the hunt. Only one of the spriggans from Jihli's dream was real: a mystical auspicious spriggan, who led the realm to a great treasure.
entries.fr: Vous avez sans doute remarqué combien les allées limséennes ont été décorées aux couleurs de cette fête. Peut-être même avez-vous entendu de nombreuses personnes parler d'un “spriggan porte-bonheurrr”... Il s'agit d'une créature étrange qui aurait visiblement un lien avec la vision de Jihli.

entries.en: It is not only the hunters who shall be changing this year, but the hunted too. While adventurers may still search for decorated eggs hidden around the cities of Eorzea, a greater challenge awaits them out in the wilds: giant, floating eggs that refuse to be taken lightly!
entries.fr: Il s'agit de quelque chose d'un peu spécial, car voyez-vous, vous devrrrez sortir de la Cité si vous comptez partir à la chasse aux Fabulœufs.

Thus have we dispatched a number of sylphic sorceresses to the locations of these mysterious monoliths, so that adventurers might join in the hunt in spriggan form. Crack them open, and collect the prizes inside!
